title: 2021年6月 第2套

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: An 81-year-old man ended up in Germany by accident after trying to get from Newcastle, Great Britain, to Rome, Italy.
lines.translation: 一位81岁的老人在试图从英国纽卡斯尔前往意大利罗马时意外到达了德国。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: The old age pensioner was on a mission to see the Pope, who is head of the Catholic Church, and decided to make his way there by car.
lines.translation: 这位领取养老金的老人此行是为了拜见天主教会领袖教皇,他决定驾车前往。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: He was surprised when his GPS system told him he had arrived, although there were no signs of any of the famous buildings or architecture.
lines.translation: 当GPS系统告诉他已经到达目的地时,他感到很惊讶,因为周围没有任何著名建筑的迹象。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: The man parked but didn't put on the handbrake of his car properly.
lines.translation: 老人停好车,但没有正确拉上手刹。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: His car rolled backwards, and in a striking display of irony, hit a sign saying "Rom"—the small town in North Germany he had mistakenly plugged into the GPS system.
lines.translation: 他的车向后滑行,极具讽刺意味的是,撞上了一块写着"Rom"的标志牌——这是他误输入GPS系统的德国北部小镇的名字。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Police said that the car had come to a halt after hitting the sign, but did not appear to be seriously damaged, although an ambulance was called to check on the pensioner.
lines.translation: 警方表示,汽车撞上标志牌后停了下来,但似乎没有严重损坏,不过还是叫了救护车来检查这位老人的身体状况。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: The man, who lives in the UK and is originally Italian, might have been confused by the fact that Rome is written "Roma" in Italian and "Rom" in German.
lines.translation: 这位生活在英国、原籍意大利的老人可能是因为罗马在意大利语中写作"Roma",而在德语中写作"Rom"而产生了混淆。

lines.translation: 第 1 题：这位领取养老金的老人计划做什么?

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: 2. What finally happened to the old man?
lines.translation: 第 2 题：这位老人最后怎么样了?

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: News Report 2.
lines.translation: 《第二次新闻报告》。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Glasgow has pledged to become the first carbon neutral city in the UK.
lines.translation: Glasgow承诺成为英国首个碳中和城市。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: The city's council and ScottishPower have announced a range of strategies in an attempt to reduce carbon emissions ahead of the new national target of 2045.
lines.translation: 该市议会和ScottishPower宣布了一系列战略，试图在2045年这一新的国家目标之前减少碳排放。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: First Minister Nicola Sturgeon welcomed the pledge, and said: "Today's announcement between ScottishPower and Glasgow City Council—to make Glasgow the UK's first net-zero city—is a very welcome step.
lines.translation: 第一大臣尼古拉·斯特金欢迎这项承诺,并说:“今天苏格兰权力与格拉斯哥市议会之间宣布格拉斯哥是联合王国第一个零净城市,这是非常值得欢迎的步骤。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Reaching our goals will need exactly this kind of partnership approach—with government, business, local authorities and citizens all playing their part."
lines.translation: 实现我们的目标需要这种伙伴关系方式——政府、企业、地方当局和公民都发挥各自的作用。”

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Speaking ahead of the All Energy Conference being held in Glasgow, ScottishPower chief executive Keith Anderson said: "We have a large supply of renewable energy on our doorstep and one of the only two low emission zones in action across the UK.
lines.translation: 在格拉斯哥(Glasgow)举行的所有能源会议之前,苏格兰国家首席执行官基思·安德森(Keith Anderson)说:“我们家门口有大量的可再生能源供应,这是联合王国全国唯一两个正在运作的低排放区之一。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Now, we need to invest in the technologies and programmes that transform the rest of Glasgow's economy and make us net zero before anyone else."
lines.translation: 现在,我们需要投资于 改变格拉斯哥经济其余部分的技术和方案 并且让我们比其他人 更接近于零。”

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: 3. What do we learn from the news report?
lines.translation: 第 3 题：我们从新闻报道中了解到什么?

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: 4. What did ScottishPower's chief executive say ahead of the All Energy Conference?
lines.translation: 第 4 题：ScottishPower的首席执行官在All Energy Conference之前说了什么?

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Report 3.
lines.translation: 报告3。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: A Japanese IT firm has officially introduced an office cat policy to combat the stressful environment of the workplace.
lines.translation: 一家日本IT公司正式推出了"办公室猫"政策,以应对压力重重的工作环境。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: A total of nine furry friends freely wander around in the office and do whatever their little hearts desire.
lines.translation: 共有九只毛茸茸的朋友在办公室里自由走动,做着它们内心想做的任何事情。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Hidenobu Fukuda, who heads the firm, introduced the pet policy, upon request from one of his employees, allowing staff to bring their own cats to work.
lines.translation: 公司负责人Hidenobu Fukuda应一位员工的要求推出了这项宠物政策,允许员工将自己的猫带到工作场所。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Employee Eri Ito is grateful for their animals' comforting ways.
lines.translation: Eri Ito员工感谢他们的动物舒适方式。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: "Cats are sleeping just beside us.
lines.translation: "猫就在我们旁边睡"

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: It's healing." she said.
lines.translation: 她说,这是治愈。"

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Not only does Fukuda encourage bringing cats to the job, but he also encourages his employees to rescue cats from overpopulated shelters or streets.
lines.translation: 福田不但鼓励猫来工作, 也鼓励员工从人口过多的收容所或街道上救猫。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: He gives 5,000 yen, about 45 US dollars a month to those who rescue a cat.
lines.translation: 他每月给那些营救猫的人 5000日元 大约45美元

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: While the positives are many, there are still some obstacles.
lines.translation: 虽然积极因素很多,但仍然存在一些障碍。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: "Sometimes a cat will walk on a phone and cut off the call, or they shut down the computers by walking onto the off switch," Ito says.
lines.translation: “有时猫会走在电话上,切断电话, 或者他们通过走在关闭的开关上关闭电脑,

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Still, cats in the workplace have been a tremendous success for the company.
lines.translation: 尽管如此,办公室里的猫对公司来说仍是一项巨大的成功。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: The policy has led to various other companies doing the same.
lines.translation: 这项政策促使其他多家公司也采取了同样的做法。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: 5. What do we learn from the news report about the Japanese IT firm?
lines.translation: 第 5 题：从新闻报道中我们了解到这家日本IT公司的什么情况?

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: 6. What does Fukuda encourage his employees to do?
lines.translation: 第 6 题：Fukuda鼓励他的员工做什么?

lines.text: 7. What does the news report say about the firm's policy?
lines.translation: 第 7 题：新闻报道对该公司政策有何评价?

lines.text: Section B. Directions.
lines.translation: B节. 指示。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: In this section, you will hear two long conversations.
lines.translation: 在本节中,你们将听到两次长长的谈话。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: At the end of each conversation,
lines.translation: 每次谈话结束时

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: you will hear four questions.
lines.translation: 你会听到四个问题。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Both the conversation and the questions will be spoken only once.
lines.translation: 谈话和问题只谈一次

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: After you hear a question, you must choose the best answer from the four choices marked A, B, C,
lines.translation: 在听到一个问题后,你必须从四个选择选择中选择最好的答案,这四个选择分别是A,B,C,

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: and D. Then mark the corresponding letter on answer sheet one with a single line through the center.
lines.translation: 然后在答题单上用单行横穿中心标出相应的字母。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Conversation one.
lines.translation: 交谈之一。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Has Jimmy been coming in lately?
lines.translation: Jimmy 最近有来吗？

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: No, I haven't seen him around.
lines.translation: 没有，我没见他在附近。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Why?
lines.translation: 怎么了？

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Has he been causing any trouble?
lines.translation: 他惹什么麻烦了吗？

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Not that I know of.
lines.translation: 据我所知没有。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: But I need to see him, because my friends and I lent him some money last month.
lines.translation: 但我需要见他，因为上个月我和朋友们借了他一些钱。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: We haven't heard from him since.
lines.translation: 从那以后就没他消息了。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: I heard he comes here a lot, so I thought I'd come in and check with you.
lines.translation: 我听说他经常来这儿，所以想过来问问你。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Well, that's funny.
lines.translation: 嗯，这倒挺有意思。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Some other fellow came in asking for Jimmy just yesterday, a real nervous, pushy type of fellow, saying he needed Jimmy for some study project they were working on.
lines.translation: 就在昨天还有个人来找 Jimmy，一个特别紧张、咄咄逼人的家伙，说他需要找 Jimmy 完成他们一起做的什么学习项目。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: But I can't quite remember what it was all about.
lines.translation: 但我记不太清具体是什么了。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Is this a lot of money we're talking about here?
lines.translation: 你们说的是一大笔钱吗？

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: No, just 60 pounds between the three of us, but still a bit too much to just let go.
lines.translation: 不是，我们三个人一共就 60 英镑，但也不至于就这么算了。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: He told us he'd got into an accident.
lines.translation: 他告诉我们他出了个事故。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Nothing serious, mind you, but he damaged someone's car and wanted to get some money together to make up for the damage he'd caused.
lines.translation: 不严重，你知道，但他撞坏了别人的车，想凑点钱赔偿他造成的损失。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Hmm, isn't that sort of thing usually covered by insurance?
lines.translation: 嗯，这种事不是通常都有保险赔吗？

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: And then, if you still wanted to give money as some sort of apology or something, he probably shouldn't have to go around borrowing it from people.
lines.translation: 而且就算你还想给钱作为某种道歉什么的，他也不应该到处找人借钱吧。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: You think Jimmy's just making it all up?
lines.translation: 你觉得吉米只是瞎编的?

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: See, I did think it was a bit weird for him to be asking for money for that sort of thing.
lines.translation: 我确实觉得他为这种事要钱 有点奇怪

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: And his story was a bit vague to begin with.
lines.translation: 他的故事一开始有点模糊。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: But I thought maybe he doesn't want his parents to know about what happened.
lines.translation: 但我想也许他不想让父母知道发生了什么

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: So he'd rather come to us and keep things quiet.
lines.translation: 所以他宁愿来找我们 保持安静

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Anyway, Jimmy is a good guy.
lines.translation: 总之 吉米是个好人

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: So we didn't make a fuss about it.
lines.translation: 所以我们没有大惊小怪

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: 8. What does the man want to do?
lines.translation: 第 8 题：这位男士想做什么?

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: 9. What do we learn about the man who came to see the woman yesterday?
lines.translation: 第 9 题：关于昨天来看这位女士的男士,我们了解到什么?

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: 10. What did Jimmy say happened to him one day?
lines.translation: 第 10 题：Jimmy说有一天他发生了什么事?

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: 11. Why did Jimmy borrow money according to the man?
lines.translation: 第 11 题：根据这位男士所说,Jimmy为什么借钱?

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Conversation 2.
lines.translation: 对话2。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Hi Max, how are you?
lines.translation: 嗨 Max 你好吗?

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: How are you?
lines.translation: 你好吗?

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Listen.
lines.translation: 听着

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: I wanted to ask you about ordering shopping online.
lines.translation: 我想问你 有关订购网上购物。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: I've never done it before and I know that you've been doing it for ages.
lines.translation: 我从来没有这样做过 我知道,你已经这样做 多年了。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Sure.
lines.translation: 当然。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: I love getting my shopping delivered.
lines.translation: 我很喜欢送货上门。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: It makes life so much simpler—no carrying heavy shopping bags in the rain, or trying to park the car on those huge supermarket car parks then not being able to find it again after you come out of the shops.
lines.translation: 这让生活简单多了——不用在雨天提着沉重的购物袋,也不用在那些超大的超市停车场停车,然后从商店出来后又找不到自己的车。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: But there must be some problems.
lines.translation: 但肯定会有些问题吧。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: I mean, how do you know that you won't get bad fruit, or that the eggs won't be broken?
lines.translation: 我是说,你怎么知道不会买到坏水果,或者鸡蛋不会破呢?

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Oh, come on.
lines.translation: 哦,别这样。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: The food is exactly the same as the stuff you buy in a conventional shop.
lines.translation: 食物和你在传统商店买的东西完全一样。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: They aren't going to deliver you food that is out of date.
lines.translation: 他们不会给你送过期的食品。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: And if you get a broken egg, well, that could happen in a conventional shop, too.
lines.translation: 如果你收到破损的鸡蛋,这在传统商店也可能发生。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: If anything is really wrong, you can just take photographs of the damage, and they will give you the money back or replace the item.
lines.translation: 如果真的有什么问题,你可以拍下损坏的照片,他们会退钱或者换货。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: How about delivery fees?
lines.translation: 送货费呢?

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Is it not more expensive to get everything delivered?
lines.translation: 送东西不更贵吗?

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: I actually found that it was cheaper for me, as I live quite far away from my local supermarket.
lines.translation: 实际上我发现对我来说更便宜,因为我住得离本地超市挺远的。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: So with the deliveries, I'm actually saving on petrol.
lines.translation: 所以有了配送服务,我实际上还节省了汽油费。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: I've never thought of that.
lines.translation: 我从没想过这一点。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: If you aren't driving your own car, then you are saving on fuel.
lines.translation: 如果你不开自己的车,那就省了油钱。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Right, you've convinced me.
lines.translation: 好吧,你说服我了。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: I'm going to go on the computer now and give it a try.
lines.translation: 我现在就去电脑上试试。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: So, which supermarket do you think is the best to order from?
lines.translation: 那么,你觉得哪家超市最值得下单?

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Oh, no.
lines.translation: 哦,不。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: That's definitely up to you.
lines.translation: 那肯定要你自己决定。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Otherwise, we'll be here all day.
lines.translation: 否则,我们得在这儿待一整天了。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: 12. What did the woman want to ask Max about?
lines.translation: 第 12 题：女士想问Max什么事情?

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: 13. What does the man think is a problem with shopping in supermarkets?
lines.translation: 第 13 题：男士认为在超市购物有什么问题?

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: 14. What is the woman's concern about shopping online?
lines.translation: 第 14 题：女士对网上购物有什么顾虑?

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: 15. What does the man find about shopping online?
lines.translation: 第 15 题：男士发现网上购物有什么特点?

lines.text: directions.
lines.translation: 方向。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: In this section you will hear three passages.
lines.translation: 在本节中,你们将听到三个段落。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: At the end of each passage you will hear three or four questions.
lines.translation: 在每一段的结尾 你会听到三个或四个问题

lines.text: Both the passage and the questions will be spoken only once.

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: mark the corresponding letter on answer sheet one with a single line through the center.
lines.translation: 在答题单单行的答题表一中标出相应的字母。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: A recent study found that 10% of British children suffer from math anxiety.
lines.translation: 最近的一项研究发现,10%的英国儿童患有数学焦虑症。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: This means they have overwhelming negative emotions towards the subject, ranging from rage to despair.
lines.translation: 这意味着他们对这门学科有压倒性的负面情绪,从愤怒到绝望不等。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Other emotions triggered by math include feelings of "tension and frustration".
lines.translation: 数学引发的其他情绪还包括"紧张和挫败感"。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Physical symptoms include a racing heart or struggling to catch breath.
lines.translation: 生理症状包括心跳加速或呼吸困难。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: The phenomenon of math anxiety is characterized as a general sense of feeling that the subject is hard compared with other subjects leading to a subsequent lack or loss of confidence.
lines.translation: 数学焦虑现象的特征是一种普遍的感觉,即认为这门学科比其他学科更难,从而导致信心不足或丧失信心。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Researchers said they investigated individuals' attitudes towards mathematics because of what could be referred to as a mathematics crisis in the UK.
lines.translation: 研究人员表示,他们之所以调查个人对数学的态度,是因为英国可以称之为数学危机的现象。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: There's a widespread misunderstanding that only low performing children suffer from math anxiety.
lines.translation: 人们普遍误解只有成绩差的儿童才会患有数学焦虑症。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: People automatically assume children are anxious about math because they are poor achievers.
lines.translation: 人们自动认为儿童对数学感到焦虑是因为他们成绩不好。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: In fact, more than three quarters of children with high levels of math anxiety are normal to high achievers.
lines.translation: 事实上,超过四分之三有高度数学焦虑的儿童是正常到高水平的成就者。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Probably their math anxiety will go unnoticed because their performance is good.
lines.translation: 他们的数学焦虑可能不会被注意到,因为他们的成绩很好。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: But in the long term their performance is negatively affected.
lines.translation: 但从长远来看,他们的表现会受到负面影响。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: So the real danger here is that children who will be completely able to do math at a normal level may keep away from it because they feel anxious.
lines.translation: 所以真正的危险在于,完全有能力达到正常水平做数学的儿童可能会远离它,因为他们感到焦虑。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Math anxiety can severely disrupt students' performance in the subject in both primary and secondary school.
lines.translation: 数学焦虑会严重扰乱学生在小学和中学阶段这门学科的表现。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: But importantly—and surprisingly—this new study suggests that the majority of students experiencing math anxiety have normal to high math ability.
lines.translation: 但重要的是——也令人惊讶的是——这项新研究表明,大多数经历数学焦虑的学生具有正常到较高的数学能力。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: 16. What did a recent study find about some British children?
lines.translation: 第 16 题：最近一项研究发现了英国儿童的什么情况?

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: 17. What is the widespread misunderstanding about math anxiety?
lines.translation: 第 17 题：关于数学焦虑的普遍误解是什么?

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: 18. What does the passage say about British students with math anxiety?
lines.translation: 第 18 题：文章关于有数学焦虑的英国学生说了什么?

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: People spend a lot of time using phones and computers.
lines.translation: 人们花费大量时间使用手机和电脑。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Much of that time is devoted to text messages and social media.
lines.translation: 这些时间大部分用于发送短信和使用社交媒体。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: But many people choose to spend their time playing computer games.
lines.translation: 但许多人选择把时间花在玩电脑游戏上。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: For years, parents and teachers have worried that these games might be addictive.
lines.translation: 多年来,家长和教师一直担心这些游戏可能会让人上瘾。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: And now, the World Health Organization has recognized addiction to computer games as a disease.
lines.translation: 现在,世界卫生组织已经将电脑游戏成瘾认定为一种疾病。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: The organization explains that this decision reflects general agreement among experts around the world that some people have a problem with these games.
lines.translation: 该组织解释说,这一决定反映了全球专家的普遍共识,即有些人在这些游戏上存在问题。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: They show a pattern of behavior characterized by a lack of control.
lines.translation: 他们表现出以缺乏控制力为特征的行为模式。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Such people make computer games a priority over their responsibilities.
lines.translation: 这些人将电脑游戏置于自己的责任之上。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: They may play games instead of attending school, or work, or socializing.
lines.translation: 他们可能不去上学、不去工作或不参加社交活动,而是玩游戏。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: According to the World Health Organization experts, people's use of computer games is different from their use of the Internet, social media and online shopping.
lines.translation: 根据世界卫生组织专家的说法,人们对电脑游戏的使用不同于他们对互联网、社交媒体和网上购物的使用。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: These experts claim there is not sufficient data to indicate that people's reliance on those other activities is an addiction.
lines.translation: 这些专家声称,没有足够的数据表明人们对其他这些活动的依赖是一种成瘾。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: But they argue that playing computer games to access is different.
lines.translation: 但他们认为,为了获取而玩电脑游戏是不同的。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: This behavior can become a disorder.
lines.translation: 这种行为可能成为一种障碍。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: To meet the new definition for addiction, the behavior must damage a person's relationships or performance at school or work, and this must last for at least a year.
lines.translation: 要符合成瘾的新定义,这种行为必须损害一个人的人际关系或在学校或工作中的表现,并且这种情况必须持续至少一年。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Still not all behavior experts agree.
lines.translation: 但并非所有行为专家都同意这一观点。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Some argue that there's not enough research on the subject.
lines.translation: 一些人认为关于这个主题的研究还不够充分。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Thus, they claim it is too early to call computer game addiction a disorder.
lines.translation: 因此,他们声称现在将电脑游戏成瘾称为一种障碍还为时过早。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: 19. What conclusion has the World Health Organization come to recently?
lines.translation: 第 19 题：世界卫生组织最近得出了什么结论?

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: 20. What is said of people with addictive behavior?
lines.translation: 第 20 题：关于有成瘾行为的人,有什么说法?

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: 21. What do some behavior experts think of addiction to computer games?
lines.translation: 第 21 题：一些行为专家如何看待电脑游戏成瘾?

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Passage 3 Maybe you carry the most powerful passport in the world or perhaps the rarest passport Whatever the case your passport will likely
lines.translation: 3号通行证 或许你携带着世界上最强大的护照 或者最珍贵的护照

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Maybe you carry the most powerful passport in the world, or perhaps the rarest passport.
lines.translation: 也许你持有世界上最强大的护照,或者可能是最稀有的护照。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Whatever the case, your passport will likely be one of four colors: red, blue, green or black, although there are slight variations.
lines.translation: 无论如何,你的护照很可能是四种颜色之一:红色、蓝色、绿色或黑色,尽管存在细微的差异。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Switzerland's passport is dark red, for example, while most European countries prefer a shade of red.
lines.translation: 例如,瑞士的护照是深红色,而大多数欧洲国家更喜欢红色的色调。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: That's almost brown.
lines.translation: 那几乎是棕色的。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: There are no official rules regarding passport colors, but countries follow a certain set of norms when designing them.
lines.translation: 关于护照颜色没有官方规定,但各国在设计护照时遵循一套特定的规范。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: The International Civil Aviation Organization, which works to define the principles of air travel, suggests that countries use a suitable type, size and style for official documents like passports.
lines.translation: 国际民用航空组织致力于定义航空旅行的原则,建议各国为护照等官方文件使用合适的类型、尺寸和样式。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: There are also a few compulsory aspects of passports.
lines.translation: 护照还有一些强制性要求。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: They must be made from a material that bends.
lines.translation: 护照必须由可弯曲的材料制成。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: They should be able to be read by a machine at temperatures ranging from 10 degrees Celsius to 50 degrees Celsius, under the conditions where the air can be extremely dry or moist.
lines.translation: 它们应当能够在10摄氏度到50摄氏度的温度范围内被机器读取,在空气可能极度干燥或潮湿的条件下。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Despite these existing recommendations, there is nothing regarding the cover color.
lines.translation: 尽管有这些建议,但关于封面颜色没有任何规定。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Why?
lines.translation: 怎么了？

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: Simply put, countries stick to darker and more conservative colors because they appear more official.
lines.translation: 简而言之,各国坚持更黑暗、更保守的颜色,因为它们看起来更正式。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: And they can also hide dirt and wear.
lines.translation: 他们也可以藏土和穿戴。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: While there's little innovation when it comes to passport cover color, the same cannot be said for the pages.
lines.translation: 虽然护照封面颜色没有什么创新, 但页面的颜色却并非如此。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: The passports of many countries can take images of their well-known geographical features and wildlife, which also function as security features as some are only visible under a special light.
lines.translation: 许多国家的护照可以摄取其众所周知的地理特征和野生生物的图像,这些特征和野生生物也起到安全特征的作用,因为有些国家只有在特别光线下才能看到。

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: 22. What do we learn about most European passports?
lines.translation: 第 22 题：关于大多数欧洲护照我们了解到什么?

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: 23. What does the passage say about the design of passports?
lines.translation: 第 23 题：文章关于护照的设计说了什么?

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: 24. Why are dark colors chosen for passport covers?
lines.translation: 第 24 题：为什么护照封面选择深色?

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: 25. What is one special function of the images inside many passports?
lines.translation: 第 25 题：许多护照内部的图像有什么特殊功能?

lines.speaker: 听力原声
lines.text: That's the end of listening comprehension.
lines.translation: 听觉理解到此结束
